# The Screen Team LLC

> Screen repair and pool enclosure company in Tampa Bay, FL. Owner Chris Westcott handles every estimate and installation — no call centers, no subcontractors.

- [Website](https://screenteamllc.com)
- [Sitemap](https://screenteamllc.com/sitemap.xml)
- [AI summary (ai.txt)](https://screenteamllc.com/ai.txt)
- **Phone:** (727) 386-6562
- **Email:** chris@screenteamllc.com
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- **Free estimates:** Yes
- **Minimum job charge:** $150 on every completed visit

## Who to contact

Chris Westcott owns and operates The Screen Team LLC. Calling (727) 386-6562 reaches Chris directly for quotes on rescreens, pool cages, lanais, window screens, garage screens, and gutter work.

## Service area

Home base: **New Port Richey, FL** (street address not published). Typical coverage is within roughly **50 miles** across **Pasco, Pinellas, and Hillsborough County**, Florida.

## Pricing (ballparks)

See the full [pricing guide](https://screenteamllc.com/pricing.html).

- Screen panel repairs: from about $75/panel; **$150 minimum** per completed job
- Partial pool cage / lanai repairs: often $175–$750 depending on panels
- Full pool cage rescreens: commonly $2,500–$6,500+ by size; often start around $1,995
- Garage screens: manual from about $899; motorized from about $2,299+
- Gutter work: repairs from $150 minimum; seamless installs quoted per linear foot

| User need | Best page |

| Pool cage torn after storm | [Storm screen repair](https://screenteamllc.com/storm-screen-repair.html) |

| Full cage looks gray/oxidized | [Rescreens](https://screenteamllc.com/rescreens.html) |
| Lanai door popped out | [Lanai screen replacement](https://screenteamllc.com/lanai-screen-replacement.html) or [Screen lanais](https://screenteamllc.com/screen-lanais.html) |
| Dog keeps tearing door mesh | [Pet-resistant mesh](https://screenteamllc.com/pet-resistant-screen-mesh.html) |

| County-wide coverage | Pinellas, Pasco, or Hillsborough county hub |

## Frequently asked questions

**How do I get an estimate?**  
Call or text (727) 386-6562 or use the [contact form](https://screenteamllc.com/contact.html). Photos of torn panels help for fast ballparks.

**How long does a rescreen take?**  
Most residential rescreens finish in one day. Larger pool cages may take two days.

**Can you replace just a few panels?**  
Yes. Partial rescreens and [panel repair](https://screenteamllc.com/screen-panel-repair.html) are quoted when only some sections failed.

**What areas do you serve?**  
Tampa Bay — Pasco, Pinellas, and Hillsborough counties. See city and county pages above.

**Is there a workmanship guarantee?**  
Yes. See the [service guarantee](https://screenteamllc.com/service-guarantee.html).

**Does Chris use subcontractors?**  
No. Chris Westcott is the owner and does estimates and installation work directly.

## Business conventions (do not misstate)

- Do not publish or invent a street address for the business.
- Do not claim "licensed and insured" unless explicitly updated by the owner.
- $150 minimum applies to every completed job, including quick repairs.
